# CHATGPT / AIJoystick snapshot

Origin: `C:\projetos\maurinsoft\CHATGPT\pacote\AI Input\AIJoystick`.
Repository: https://github.com/marcelomaurin/CHATGPT

New local component added on 2026-10-11; not yet published upstream.
This snapshot is identical to that component and uses the CHATGPT repository
license included here. It depends on `aibase` from the existing shared library.

Build tooling uses the external AIJoystick directory when available, with
this snapshot as a fallback for older library revisions (including CI).
Synchronize both copies when changing this component. No third-party
joystick DLL is redistributed.
